newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices track U.S. treasuries up.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices track U.S. treasuries up.

text.p: Danish bond prices rose on Friday morning, with U.S. treasury gains for the moment overcoming fears of a new Fed rate rise.
"Sentiment is good and it is not allowing (next Wednesday's) FOMC meeting to put a damper on things," a dealer said.

At 0915 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was up 0.17 point from Thursday's close, at 111.54, yielding 6.25 percent.The forthcoming benchmark seven percent state bond due 2007 edged up 0.03 point, to 103.90, yielding 6.46 percent.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 gained 0.40 point, to 90.15 and the crown firmed to 3.8080 per mark from 3.8090.
The yield gap between the 2006 bond and the German bund was unchanged at 56 basis points but the 2007-bund gap widened three basis points to 78 bp. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
